$comment: design-audit — copy to <repo>/.stylelintrc.json. The at-rule whitelist is required for Tailwind v4 (@theme/@utility/@apply/@custom-variant...); add project-specific ignores rather than silencing rules. at-rule-prelude-no-invalid is off because it misreads Tailwind @apply preludes (e.g. `@apply border-border outline-ring/50`). import-notation is pinned to "string": Tailwind v4 only resolves @import "tailwindcss" — auto-fixing it to url() silently emits an unstyled build.
